variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: A machine translation system turns a message in a source language into a target-language message that preserves the intended meaning. The model generates the words, but the production system also detects language, protects names and placeholders, applies approved terminology, estimates quality, and decides whether the result is safe to release.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Normalize deliberately
pairs.explanation: Choose and version normalization rules. Visually similar code points, combining marks, and compatibility forms can otherwise fragment evaluation and caching.

pairs.label: Share with evidence
pairs.detail: A multilingual vocabulary can transfer signal across related scripts, but high-resource languages can consume disproportionate capacity.
pairs.explanation: A multilingual vocabulary can transfer signal across related scripts, but high-resource languages can consume disproportionate capacity. Measure fragmentation per language.

pairs.label: Protect before tokenizing
pairs.detail: Replace placeholders, markup, IDs, and immutable terms with typed sentinels, then verify exact restoration after decoding.
pairs.explanation: Replace placeholders, markup, IDs, and immutable terms with typed sentinels, then verify exact restoration after decoding.

pairs.label: Version as one unit
pairs.detail: Model weights, tokenizer, language tags, normalization, and glossary behavior form one deployable contract.
pairs.explanation: Model weights, tokenizer, language tags, normalization, and glossary behavior form one deployable contract. Rolling back only one can corrupt output.

variants.hint:
Normalize deliberately: Choose and version normalization rules.

Share with evidence: A multilingual vocabulary can transfer signal across related scripts, but high-resource languages can consume disproportionate capacity.

Protect before tokenizing: Replace placeholders, markup, IDs, and immutable terms with typed sentinels, then verify exact restoration after decoding.

Version as one unit: Model weights, tokenizer, language tags, normalization, and glossary behavior form one deployable contract.

variants.prompt: What is the core production invariant for machine translation?
options: Release only when meaning and protected facts remain attributable to the source.
Always choose the candidate with the highest model probability.
Use one global quality score for every language.
Translate every request even when the language pair is unsupported.
variants.explanation: Fluency and model preference do not excuse changed numbers, missing placeholders, unsafe additions, or unsupported source meaning.
